⁡
【 Addictive Cabbage 】
⁡
One of Japan’s classic izakaya-style dishes! 🇯🇵🍻
⁡
In Japan, this dish is called Yamitsuki Cabbage (やみつきキャベツ).
⁡
“Yamitsuki” means addictive or irresistibly delicious—the kind of dish you just can’t stop eating! 🤤
⁡
Ingredients
- 200g cabbage (I don't know if the cabbage in your country can be eaten raw. If you are concerned, please check before preparing it.)
⭐︎ 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder
⭐︎ 2 tsp soy sauce
⭐︎ 1 tbsp sesame oil
⭐︎ A pinch of salt
⭐︎ A little black pepper
⁡
🌱 For vegans
Please use vegan chicken-style bouillon powder instead of chicken bouillon powder.

💡 About Cabbage: In Japan, we usually use regular round cabbage. In Germany, I use Spitzkohl because it has fewer tough white parts and is delicious even when eaten raw.

⁡
⁡
1. Roughly chop the cabbage.
2. Put the cabbage in a plastic bag and add all the ⭐︎ seasonings.
3. Seal the bag, mix and massage everything well.
4. Refrigerate for about 20 minutes to let the flavors soak in.
⁡
That’s it! Easy, crunchy, and seriously addictive. 🤤🥬
⁡
⁡
Follow me for more easy recipes!
ありがとう🙏🏻✨ (🇯🇵Arigatou: Thank you, Danke)
⁡
#japan #cabbage #japanesefood #easyrecipes #japanesefoodlover".
